Mira (config): Quick proposal: generate compact preview token for bulk flag edits so teams can share diffs without applying. Minimal fields?

Jon (console): preview_id, changed_keys list, affected_tenants_est, estimate. Dry-run only. UI: 2-col diff + export.

Eli (sre): Safety: batch limit 300, require ops ack >2000 tenants, auto-pause if +1% abs 5xx in 10m. Advisory lock visible via API.

Nia (telemetry): Capture baseline snapshot_id with rps,p95,5xx. Tag with X-Preview-Id. Emit small report every 60s for 15m: preview_id|metric:baseline:current:delta_pct.

Mira (config): Actions: Jon -> POC endpoint /config/preview, Nia -> collector changes, Eli -> runbook snippet. reference preview_id:1850000001 in PRs.

ops-bot: Reminder: config maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC.

Jon (console): Ack, will return POC by Friday. :thumbsup:
